overview.description: The John Hancock Large Cap Opportunities ETF (JLCO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through exposure to large-cap US equity securities. Security selection is based on a fundamental, bottom-up research process. JLCO was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by John Hancock.

holdings.infoBox: JLCO is an equity ETF with a total of 56 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 7.89%, Alphabet at 6.90%, Amazon.com at 6.06%, NVIDIA at 5.16%, and Broadcom at 4.44%.
